# Breastmilk

<section class="hmi-quick-read" id="breastmilk-quick-read" data-hmi-quick-read aria-labelledby="breastmilk-quick-read-label"><div class="hmi-quick-read-label" id="breastmilk-quick-read-label">Quick read</div>

Breastmilk in the HMI library has 1,008 reported results for lead, cadmium, total arsenic, total mercury, methylmercury, nickel, chromium, aluminium, tin, uranium, Co, Cu, Fe, Mn, Zn, Se, Ba, Be, Ca, K, Mg, Mo, Na, S, Th and Tl from 17 sources.<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/bzikowska-jura2024-human-milk-elements-poland|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Agnieszka Bzikowska-Jura, Aleksandra Wesolowska, Piotr Sobieraj, Agnieszka Nawrocka, Aleksandra Filipek, Maciej Durkalec, Danuta Katrynska, Piotr Jedziniak · 2024</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/bzikowska-jura2024-human-milk-elements-poland">Essential and non-essential element concentrations in human milk samples and the assessment of infants&#39; exposure</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Scientific Reports 14:8140</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/bzikowska-jura2024-human-milk-elements-poland">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/chen2023-breast-milk-ewaste-china|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Chen C, Ma C, Li Q, Hang JG, Shen J, Nakayama SF, Kido T, Lin Y, Feng H, Jung CR, Sun XL, Lou J · 2023</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/chen2023-breast-milk-ewaste-china">Prenatal Exposure to Heavy Metals and Adverse Birth Outcomes: Evidence From an E-Waste Area in China</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GeoHealth</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/chen2023-breast-milk-ewaste-china">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/digangi1997-greenpeace-vinyl-children-products|4]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Di Gangi, Joseph · 1997</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/digangi1997-greenpeace-vinyl-children-products">Lead and Cadmium in Vinyl Children&#39;s Products: A Greenpeace Exposé</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Greenpeace USA (Washington, DC); </li>
<li>
<strong>Main drivers:</strong>

Form, basis and where the breastmilk was sampled; reporting limits decide how many results are non-detects.<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/bzikowska-jura2024-human-milk-elements-poland|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Agnieszka Bzikowska-Jura, Aleksandra Wesolowska, Piotr Sobieraj, Agnieszka Nawrocka, Aleksandra Filipek, Maciej Durkalec, Danuta Katrynska, Piotr Jedziniak · 2024</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/bzikowska-jura2024-human-milk-elements-poland">Essential and non-essential element concentrations in human milk samples and the assessment of infants&#39; </li>

Ask for lot results with a quantification limit well below the limit that applies in the destination market.<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/bzikowska-jura2024-human-milk-elements-poland|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Agnieszka Bzikowska-Jura, Aleksandra Wesolowska, Piotr Sobieraj, Agnieszka Nawrocka, Aleksandra Filipek, Maciej Durkalec, Danuta Katrynska, Piotr Jedziniak · 2024</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/bzikowska-jura2024-human-milk-elements-poland">Essential and non-essential element concentrations in human milk samples and the assessment of infants&#39; <div class="hmi-analyte-explorer" id="hmi-occurrence-breastmilk" data-analyte-explorer data-compact-intro="true" data-source-summaries="true"><details class="hmi-drawer-disclosure" data-explorer-context><summary data-open-context aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-controls="hmi-occurrence-breastmilk-drawer">Comparison methods and scope</summary><div data-explorer-context-content>

<p>Each row is one statistic a source reports for one form of breastmilk, group and metal; percentiles, ranges and maxima reported for the same samples as a mean or median are shown on that row. Different forms and preparation states are kept apart, and dry-weight results never share a reference with as-sold or fresh-weight results. Ratings place a result against an HMI reference built from monitoring results and ordinary-setting medians for the same form and basis. Same-study contrasts compare a contaminated or treated site with its control, targeted with random sampling, a prepared form with the unprocessed one, or one group of a study with the median of its other groups. Held rows failed a check against their own source and are shown but not compared.</p>

<a id="universal-faqs"></a>
## Breastmilk FAQs

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="what-heavy-metals-are-found-in-breastmilk" data-anchor="what-heavy-metals-are-found-in-breastmilk" data-question="What heavy metals are found in breastmilk?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>What heavy metals are found in breastmilk?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

The library reports lead, cadmium, total arsenic, total mercury, methylmercury, nickel, chromium, aluminium, tin, uranium, Co, Cu, Fe, Mn, Zn, Se, Ba, Be, Ca, K, Mg, Mo, Na, S, Th and Tl in breastmilk, most often lead, cadmium and total arsenic.<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/bzikowska-jura2024-human-milk-elements-poland|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Agnieszka Bzikowska-Jura, Aleksandra Wesolowska, Piotr Sobieraj, Agnieszka Nawrocka, Aleksandra Filipek, Maciej Durkalec, Danuta Katrynska, Piotr Jedziniak · 2024</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/bzikowska-jura2024-human-milk-elements-poland">Essential and non-essential element concentrations in human milk samples and the assessment of infants&#39;
